_comment: Document numbers PlusMinus ALLOCATED and then DELETED. They will never be exported, so a gap
where one sits is closed, not pending — and `check-doc-sequences` reports them as such instead
of counting them missing and exiting 1.
A number belongs here only on the operator's word that the source document was deleted. It is
NOT a place to silence a gap nobody has explained: a deleted document brought no stock on
either side, so if a quantity difference was being attributed to one of these, that attribution
is wrong and the difference still needs a cause.
Keyed by org slug, then by document family as `check-doc-sequences` names them
